0022600142.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0, 1st in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (2-2, 7th in the West) for the Thunder's fifth game of the 2026-27 season. Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Ajay Mitchell (ankle) is listed as day-to-day. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Kyrie Irving (knee) and Naji Marshall (illness) also day-to-day, and the teams have not met yet this season. The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 100-87 victory in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
